# apipbx_call_recording_policy (Resource)

Which of an extension's calls are recorded. Import with "<tenant id>/<extension id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `extension_id` (String) The extension whose calls are recorded.
- `mode` (String) inbound (calls it answers), outbound (calls it makes) or both. Destroying the resource turns recording off.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
